elements.text: Captain's inappropriate decision to fly a nonstandard route
Captain's failure to maintain adequate terrain clearance
Operator's failure to require flight crews to file and fly a defined route of flight
Operator's failure to ensure flight crews adhered to company policies and FAA/DoD safety regulations
Lack of in-country oversight by the FAA and DoD of the operator
Operator's failure to adequately mitigate limited communications capability at remote sites
